title: atriplex patula var. triangularis
intro: Atriplex patula var. triangularis, commonly known as orach, is a perennial plant species in the Amaranthaceae family. It is rich in nutrients and has been used for its health benefits, including being a rich source of vitamins A and C, calcium, and iron, making it beneficial for improving eye health, boosting the immune system, and supporting bone health. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in wound healing, reducing oxidative stress, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of orach include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
